input.answer: It's savings that come out of my salary: my boss can put in up to 7.5% and I put in 2.5%, and if I leave it for 6 years from the first payment I can take it all out with no tax. Take it out sooner and you pay tax. So yes, I'm keeping it, though the example only showed it beating a normal investment account by about 415 ₪ and the fees in shekels were bigger, which put me off a bit.

stuck.where: Comparison result, top of screen 2 (17,370 ₪ vs 16,955 ₪, 'ההפרש... 415.84 ₪ יותר')
stuck.why: Over 10 years that's a tiny gap, so I wasn't sure it's actually worth locking the money up for 6 years. I didn't get far enough to see whether my boss's 7.5% is counted in it.

stuck.where: Costs table in the example (עלויות 2,402.23 ₪ vs 466.12 ₪)
stuck.why: In shekels the keren's fees look five times higher. That scared me even though it still came out ahead.
There's a minus there. So in some cases it comes out worse? I didn't get which ones.
Didn't touch it. The default of 10 years was fine for me.
